main_text.l: Exemplar verò secuti sumus Antuerpiense, colla-
tis insuper vetustis quibusdam MSS. Bibliis,
& aliis melioris notæ impressis, Venetis, Basileensi-
bus aliisque, etiam Manassis Ben Israel, nuper
Amstelodami ab ipso magnâ diligentiâ editis.
Distinctionem verò capitum & versuum ab Ec-
clesiâ hodiè receptam secuti sumus, omissis
Iudæorum Parashis & Sidris, de quibus tamen in
Apparatu. Varias verò lectiones, seu Keri, &
Ketib, cum jetir, & Chaser, &c. de quarum ori-
gine, usu, numero, &c. magnâ hodiè inter doctos a-
gitantur controversiæ (de quibus cū aliis ad Ma-
joram spectantibus in Apparatu) circello, no-
tisque pro more usitatis, additiones singulas no-
tamus. Literas etiam majusculas, & minusculas,
suspensas, inversas, &c. cum vocibus non puncta-
tis, & quæ punctas vocales habent sine literis,
in quibus mysteria magna inesse credunt non-
nulli cum Rabbinis, licet magni haud æstimanda,
ne aliquid deesse quisquam suspicaretur, retinui-
mus. Punctationem etiam usitatam, licet à Ma-
forethis textui appositam, adhibuimus; non quòd
ipsorum authoritate nitatur, sed quòd ab Ecclesiâ
Christiana, cui tam Hebraicorum V. Testamenti
quàm Græcorum Novi fœderis voluminum cura
à Deo mandata est, queque semper etiam in den-
sissimis ignorantiæ tenebris, exemplaria Hebr.
MSS. in Bibliothecis habuit, virôsque quosdam
tam hujus quàm aliarum linguarum peritos, re-
cepta est. Non enim ad Iudæos ex quo populus Dei
esse desierunt, sed ad Ecclesiam Christianam
pertinuit codicum Hebraorum custodiam; nec enim
est punctatio vera quia à Maforethis, sed quia
concordat cum vero vocalium sono, quem Spiritus

page.notes: Page ends mid-word: "Spiri-" continues on the next line with "tus" set apart at the lower right, which I have transcribed as the final catchword-like line. Several words are in italic (Exemplar, Antuerpiense, MSS., etc. are set roman with italic running text as printed); italic passages are not marked here because the scan is a reduced-resolution image and the typeface was difficult to separate reliably. Doubtful readings: "Chaser" (likely Chaser/Chasar), "circello" (possibly a printed abbreviation), "Majoram" (likely Majorem/Majora), "cū" and "etiam" in the first lines. The text is a close reading and should be checked against the scan; the Latin has been rendered in normalised u/v and i/j per instructions, but the printed Hebrew and Greek references are absent from this page.
